subject.title: Feature Request: Add premium request % to /usage footer

question: Should active-provider quota windows become part of the built-in per-response footer, and if so should they appear only in `/usage full` or also in `/usage tokens`?
rationale: Current main has the generic data seam, but the documented split between `/status` provider quota and per-response usage is an intentional user-visible policy boundary that code inspection cannot choose.

options.title: Add to full only
options.body: Append generic prepared quota windows to `/usage full` while preserving `/usage tokens` as the compact token-only mode.

options.title: Add to both modes
options.body: Show quota windows in both `/usage tokens` and `/usage full`, accepting a longer default per-response footer for users of either mode.

options.title: Keep status-only
options.body: Retain provider quota in `/status` and custom usage templates, then close this request as not planned for the built-in footer.

recommendation.title: Add to full only
recommendation.body: Append generic prepared quota windows to `/usage full` while preserving `/usage tokens` as the compact token-only mode.

likelyOwner.reason: They own substantial provider-usage and response-usage history and already provided the maintainer-level implementation guidance on this issue.
